    12  /-!
    13  # Jordan decomposition
    14  
    15  This file proves the existence and uniqueness of the Jordan decomposition for signed measures.
    16  The Jordan decomposition theorem states that, given a signed measure `s`, there exists a
    17  unique pair of mutually singular measures `μ` and `ν`, such that `s = μ - ν`.
    18  
    19  The Jordan decomposition theorem for measures is a corollary of the Hahn decomposition theorem and
    20  is useful for the Lebesgue decomposition theorem.
    21  
    22  ## Main definitions
    23  
    24  * `MeasureTheory.JordanDecomposition`: a Jordan decomposition of a measurable space is a
    25    pair of mutually singular finite measures. We say `j` is a Jordan decomposition of a signed
    26    measure `s` if `s = j.posPart - j.negPart`.
    27  * `MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.toJordanDecomposition`: the Jordan decomposition of a
    28    signed measure.
    29  * `MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.toJordanDecompositionEquiv`: is the `Equiv` between
    30    `MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure` and `MeasureTheory.JordanDecomposition` formed by
    31    `MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.toJordanDecomposition`.
    32  
    33  ## Main results
    34  
    35  * `MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.toSignedMeasure_toJordanDecomposition` : the Jordan
    36    decomposition theorem.
    37  * `MeasureTheory.JordanDecomposition.toSignedMeasure_injective` : the Jordan decomposition of a
    38    signed measure is unique.
    39  
    40  ## Tags
    41  
    42  Jordan decomposition theorem
    43  -/
    44  
    45  @[expose] public section
    46  
    47  
    48  noncomputable section
    49  
    50  open scoped MeasureTheory ENNReal NNReal
    51  
    52  variable {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    53  
    54  namespace MeasureTheory
    55  
    56  /-- A Jordan decomposition of a measurable space is a pair of mutually singular,
    57  finite measures. -/
    58  @[ext]
    59  structure JordanDecomposition (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] where
    60    /-- Positive part of the Jordan decomposition -/
    61    posPart : Measure α
    62    /-- Negative part of the Jordan decomposition -/
    63    negPart : Measure α
    64    [posPart_finite : IsFiniteMeasure posPart]
    65    [negPart_finite : IsFiniteMeasure negPart]
    66    mutuallySingular : posPart ⟂ₘ negPart
    67  
    68  attribute [instance] JordanDecomposition.posPart_finite
    69  
    70  attribute [instance] JordanDecomposition.negPart_finite
    71  
    72  namespace JordanDecomposition
    73  
    74  open Measure VectorMeasure
    75  
    76  variable (j : JordanDecomposition α)
    77  
    78  instance instZero : Zero (JordanDecomposition α) where zero := ⟨0, 0, MutuallySingular.zero_right⟩
    79  
    80  instance instInhabited : Inhabited (JordanDecomposition α) where default := 0
"}]
